summary: ADR-0095 selects enforced resource containment for a new immutable UTEL profile and separately authorized fresh original, initially one operational construction and one retained original. Before admission, exact protected source, delivered artifacts, runtime and configuration must bind finite execution, storage, transport and recipient limits with owners, units, enforcement, multiplicity, lifetime, independent readback, overload actions and exclusions. Required missing or unlimited limits refuse admission. Suppliers propose numeric budgets and justified headroom from actual integrated success, maximum-valid-input, stress and fault journeys; Programme accepts them in the exact profile. Budgets remain unset; no fixed percentage or measured universal maximum is asserted. The selected profile requires independent enforcement/readback, durable reservation/fencing/recovery, authenticated original clocks, owned recipients and safe refusal or consumed Unknown under pressure. Source acceptance and installed/runtime acceptance remain separate; public CI requires no private provider source or credentials. Authority principals/custody, original joins, one-use ACK gates, same-token independently observed HTTP204, 270/285/300-second cutoffs and nonrenewing 90-day eligibility remain mandatory. Uncertain effects, expiry or cleanup preserve bounded held allocation and original-effect holds; no restart/replay or unproved capacity reuse follows. This decision supplies no universal physical-copy bound, physical erasure or availability promise. It complements github/original-103-authentication-domain-policy and github/closed-callback-source-construction without superseding them. Legacy cap65536, physical bound null, fit unproved and admission false remain; original .103 attempted-unknown/unreplayed, .104 held and all439 inherited reservations survive. V3 priority7 records the selected fresh objective; implementation, production budgets and fresh-profile/original admission remain pending. No credential, deployment, native execution, dispatch, release, registry/schema or proof-admission change follows.
title: Fresh UTEL profiles select enforced resource containment while legacy proof and holds remain
